metadata.name: manual_clip_friendly_5_prompts_per_class_v6
metadata.style: Semantic-preserving CLIP-friendly surveillance prompts with improved class separation.
design_notes: Prompts preserve anomaly class semantics while emphasizing visible frame-level evidence.
Descriptions avoid excessive temporal reasoning because VadCLIP aligns frame-level visual features.
Similar classes are separated by emphasizing different visual cues and contexts.
Prompts are designed for text-visual similarity analysis.

Abuse: physical abuse where one person repeatedly hurts another person in a close environment
a person being subjected to repeated physical violence by another person
a person aggressively grabbing and hurting another person indoors
a person repeatedly attacking someone who appears unable to escape
domestic violence involving physical harm between two people
Arrest: police arresting and restraining a suspect with handcuffs
law enforcement officers detaining a person during an arrest
a police officer holding a detained suspect in custody
a person being arrested by uniformed police officers
police officers surrounding and controlling a detained person
Arson: a person intentionally setting fire to a building or object
a person starting a fire using a lighter or flammable material
a deliberate fire being created on someone's property
a person causing flames on an object or structure
a scene showing a person involved in setting property on fire
Assault: a person physically attacking another person with punches or kicks
one person violently striking another person during an assault
a person hitting or kicking someone in a one-sided physical attack
a person attacking another individual in a public place
a victim being physically assaulted by a single attacker
Burglary: a person illegally entering a building to steal property
a burglar breaking into a house or restricted building
a person forcing entry into a closed building
an intruder searching inside a building after unauthorized entry
a person entering private property without permission
Explosion: a sudden explosion causing fire, smoke, and flying debris
a powerful blast destroying an object or structure
an explosive event with a large fireball and smoke cloud
a scene showing damage caused by an explosive blast
a violent explosion producing scattered debris and destruction
Fighting: two or more people physically fighting each other
a group of people involved in a violent fight or brawl
multiple people punching and attacking each other
people engaging in mutual physical combat
a public fight where both sides are physically attacking
Normal: normal daily activity with people walking calmly in public areas
ordinary people and vehicles moving in a regular environment
people shopping or standing normally without unusual activity
a normal street scene with everyday human activity
routine activities occurring in a public place
RoadAccidents: vehicles involved in a traffic accident on a road
a damaged vehicle after a collision or crash
a car or motorcycle accident causing road damage
vehicles colliding and creating a traffic accident scene
a roadway with crashed vehicles after an accident
Robbery: a person threatening another person while taking their belongings
a robbery where someone uses intimidation or force to steal property
a person confronting a victim and demanding valuables
an armed person committing a robbery against another person
a criminal taking possessions from someone through threats
Shooting: a person firing a gun at another person
an armed person aiming and shooting a firearm
a shooting incident involving a visible gun
a person using a firearm during a violent event
a gun being fired in a public area
Shoplifting: a person secretly taking merchandise from a store without paying
a shopper hiding store products inside clothing or a bag
a person stealing items from a retail store
a customer leaving a shop with concealed merchandise
a person removing store goods without permission
Stealing: a person taking another person's property without permission
a person secretly stealing an unattended object
a person removing someone's belongings and leaving
a thief taking personal property in a public place
a person carrying away stolen items
Vandalism: a person intentionally damaging public or private property
a person destroying or defacing objects without taking them
a person damaging a wall, vehicle, or public facility
property being damaged through vandalism or destruction
a person breaking or marking property in a destructive way
